xinjianxue-skill-family-harmony-global v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "Family Harmony Advisor" skill package for XinJianXue.
- Provides relationship analysis, personality & behavior reading, and emotional guidance using XinJianXue methodology.
- Strict activation conditions: only analyzes if user specifically requests this advisor and clearly agrees to analyze themselves or another mentioned party.
- Introduces an onboarding process: requires AI business license application and pairing with user-provided authorization code before first use.
- Direct HTTP API integration with XinJianXue; dual license + api_key authentication required for all subsequent calls.
- Explicit exclusion for general chatting, analysis of unmentioned or unauthorized third parties, and out-of-scope questions.
